<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen-reference.mjs. Do not edit. -->

Aurora's tokens are CSS custom properties. They are defined in
[`style/tokens.css`](https://github.com/colliery-io/aurora/blob/main/aurora-leptos/style/tokens.css),
and hyper sets its own values in
[`style/hyper.css`](https://github.com/colliery-io/aurora/blob/main/aurora-leptos/style/hyper.css).
This page is made from those two files.

The swatch shows the token in the theme that this site shows now. Change the
theme with the select in the header to see the other values.

## Colours

A colour token holds a light and a dark value: `--x: light-dark(<light>, <dark>)`.
"The same" means that one value serves each theme. In hyper, "the dark value"
means that hyper does not set the token: hyper has a dark base, so the token
takes its dark value. A `-bg` token is a tint of its hue, so it follows the
hue in each theme.

In Rust, `token::X` is the string `"var(--x)"`. The tokens with no Rust
constant are used by the stylesheet; in Rust, write `"var(--name)"`.

## Radii

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--radius-xs` | `2px` |
| `--radius-sm` | `4px` |
| `--radius-md` | `8px` |
| `--radius-lg` | `16px` |
| `--radius-xl` | `32px` |
| `--radius-pill` | `10px` |
| `--radius-panel` | `11px` |
| `--radius-chip` | `20px` |

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--space-xs` | `10px` |
| `--space-sm` | `12px` |
| `--space-md` | `16px` |
| `--space-lg` | `20px` |
| `--space-xl` | `32px` |

## Colour helpers in Rust

These functions are in `aurora_leptos::tokens`.

| Function | Gives |
|---|---|
| `tint(color, pct)` | `color` at `pct` per cent opacity: `color-mix(in srgb, <color> <pct>%, transparent)`. |
| `fill_for(color)` | The fill for `color`: `var(--x-bg)` for a hue token, else an 11% tint. |
| `fg_for(color)` | The text colour on that fill: `var(--x-fg)` for a hue token, else `color`. |
| `pill_bg(color)` | The same as `fill_for`. |
| `status_color(status)` | The hue token of a status text (see [Components](../components/#statusbadge)). |
